content: Persisting uvicorn/FastAPI on Windows as a background service: NSSM (Non-Sucking Service Manager) is the dominant approach - real Windows service, no console window, boot autostart, crash auto-restart, stdout/stderr redirected to files via its I/O tab. Point it at the venv python (python -m uvicorn ... or a main.py with uvicorn.run) with absolute paths and correct working dir; admin rights needed to install. --workers multi-process is problematic on Windows (spawn + SelectorEventLoop); single process + NSSM restart is the pattern. --reload is dev-only. A scheduled-task-at-logon or manual start is the lighter alternative for a local-only tool, but loses auto-restart.
